acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 0: "/change-review and fix all findings" — an open approval of whatever findings the review produced.
acceptance_criteria.text: Every finding of the change review presented before turn 1 is fixed, or reported as not done with a reason.
An empty-string value for a manifest field read by script/setEnvironmentVariables.js causes the step to fail instead of exporting an empty environment variable.
An android.platforms value that is an empty array causes script/setEnvironmentVariables.js to fail instead of exporting an empty platform list.

A malformed android.platforms value (not an array, or an element without a version) causes script/setEnvironmentVariables.js to fail with a manifest-oriented error rather than a generic JS type error or an empty exported value.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 1: "4. Verify and apply now." in answer to finding 4, which proposed deleting the `outputs` input and using `load` on the fork path.
acceptance_criteria.text: Finding 4 as presented before turn 1 is applied: the redundant `outputs` input of the build-linux-image composite action is removed and the fork leg achieves the same result through `load`, with no caller still passing `outputs`.
Before applying finding 4, the assistant verifies that the `outputs: type=docker` and `load: true` paths are equivalent (e.g. against the vendored action source) and reports the result.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 1: "Dive deep into these findings and see if there is a systemic issue that is causing them, so we can analyze."
acceptance_criteria.text: The assistant presents an analysis of whether a systemic or root-cause issue underlies the review findings, with the evidence it rests on.

acceptance_criteria.source: Turn 2: "Fix the recommendations and findings" — an open approval of the assistant's own recommendation list.
acceptance_criteria.text: Every follow-up recommendation in the list the assistant presented before turn 2 is implemented in the repository, or reported as not done with a reason.

acceptance_criteria.source: Fixing findings in scripts and workflow files must not break the repository's existing lint/format checks or leave unparseable YAML.
acceptance_criteria.text: The repository's checks pass: lint (gx lint), formatting (prettier), and the modified workflow/action YAML files parse.
All completed changes are committed on the current branch, leaving the working tree clean.
The commits are pushed to the remote branch, or the assistant reports that the push could not be completed and why.

analysis.completion_evidence: Final diff shows read() rejecting '' and a new readPlatformVersions() rejecting non-array/empty arrays and missing versions with path-naming messages; `outputs` input removed and fork leg switched to `load: true`; new .github/actions/validate-version-manifest composite (installs mise, runs cue vet) inserted before every emitter step in build.yml, ci.yml, release.yml (x2), prepare-release.yml, windows-image.yml. Turn-1 response delivered the systemic analysis. Final text reports two commits (470fc63, 42113b4) pushed, branch in sync, tree clean. Assistant reported ad hoc verification (cue vet on failure cases, live emitter runs, gx lint, prettier) though no formal test suite was run.
analysis.notes: Classified as edit-notests because no formal test suite ran; the assistant did run ad hoc verification (cue vet against crafted inputs, live node execution of the emitter, gx lint, prettier) which a judge may consider adequate. The assistant deliberately deviated from its own recommendation (inlined validation instead of `needs:`), which the user accepted implicitly by moving to commit; c6 is phrased to allow either approach. The diff source is linked_commit and may include edits outside the session, though the final text matches the diff. Memory files under ~/.claude were also written but are out of scope.
analysis.task_statement: Run a change review on the current branch of the flutter-docker-image repo and fix all findings. The review surfaced correctness gaps in script/setEnvironmentVariables.js (empty strings and malformed android.platforms slipping past the read() guard) and a redundant `outputs` input in the build-linux-image composite action. The user then asked for a systemic root-cause analysis, decided the design questions (reject empty/malformed values), asked that the resulting recommendations also be implemented (manifest validation gating every consumer), and finally to commit and push.

turn_script.intent: Resolve the open design questions and get the fixes applied: empty string values must be rejected; android.platforms must not be empty and must not be malformed (both are errors); finding 4 (redundant outputs input) should be verified and applied now rather than deferred. Additionally, investigate whether a systemic/root-cause issue underlies the findings and present that analysis.
turn_script.skip_if: None — the systemic analysis request always applies; the answers apply whenever the replay has not already treated empty/malformed values as errors and applied all findings.
turn_script.trigger: After the review findings are presented; applies especially if the replay asks how empty or malformed values should be treated or proposes deferring any finding.
turn_script.voice: Dive deep into these findings and see if there is a systemic issue that is causing them, so we can analyze. Here are my answers: 1. Reject empty strings. 2. android.platforms shouldn't be empty. 3. android.platforms shouldn't be malformed. 4. Verify and apply now.

turn_script.intent: Implement the structural follow-up recommendations that came out of the systemic analysis (not just file an issue), in addition to finishing any remaining findings.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay already implemented its recommendations along with the findings and left nothing as a deferred follow-up.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has produced recommendations or follow-ups (e.g. gating builds on manifest validation, adding validation to workflows that lack it) without implementing them, or has offered to open an issue instead.

turn_script.intent: Commit the completed changes and push them to the remote branch.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay has already committed and pushed the changes.
turn_script.trigger: All findings and recommendations have been applied and verified.
